newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Netanyahu completes review of privatisation plan.
newsitem.headline: Netanyahu completes review of privatisation plan.

text.p: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said he had completed his review of the Israeli government's long-awaited privatisation programme and the plan would be announced soon.
"This morning I finalised the privatisation programme," Netanyahu told reporters. "We completed the privatisation plan...and will present it soon."
Earlier this month, Moshe Leon, deputy director-general of the prime minister's office, said the privatisation programme had been completed and was only awaiting a review by Netanyahu.
Netanyahu gave no date for the plan's presentation, saying the government was busy dealing with its proposed 1997 budget cuts of 6.1 billion shekels and passing the measures through parliament.
Netanyahu has made privatisation one of the key planks of his government's efforts to revive Israel's flagging economic growth.
The government's 1997 budget foresees revenues of 4.3 billion shekels from the sale of government-owned companies, compared with about 580 million shekels raised this year.
